panels.title: migration matrix — how this dashboard is used

options.content:
**This dashboard IS the 7-day parallel period.** Production panels keep reading raw; each series pair below shows what the switch WOULD do. Per item: watch 7 days, daily integral delta must stay within ±2% (or every excursion explained), then flip that production panel's query (git revert = rollback; raw data is never touched), stamp an annotation. The join here mirrors broker/kconsume.py — the canonical order: truncate 5m → light_context → k_adopted → multiply at raw time → only then aggregate. Fallbacks multiply the per-target seed (lux 1.0 / PPFD CAL 0.0017469), so an uncalibrated system shows corrected == raw. Every join input is padded with a __dummy__ row so no join ever sees an empty input stream (the Flux join package errors on those); the dummies pair off harmlessly at 1970 and are filtered out before anything renders.

| # | consumer | this dashboard | production flip |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | air.json Spectrum PPFD | panel: spectrum PPFD | after 7d + user OK |
| 2 | air.json DLI-lux / daily.json 總 lux | panel: main lux + flag map + delta gate | after 7d + user OK |
| 3 | daily.json 遮燈 DLI | panel: ref lux | after 7d + user OK |
| 4 | canary 基準 | after item 2 flips | re-baseline |
| 5 | ppfd-cal-daily.sh / cal-review-reminder.sh | after item 1 flips | read the bucket or retire |
| 6 | **light.py 控制 DLI** | **NOT here — separate user approval, stays raw until then** | — |

---

**這個閘門只看得見 13.4% 的光。** 過去 30 天的積分 lux 有 **84.1%** 落在 `mixed` cell，而 v1 對混合光是**刻意不修正**的（`kconsume.py:68` 在矩陣檢查之前就 return）。理由見 `PHOTONE-CAL-PLAN.md:38`：mixed 的 k 只是 **k_observed**，隨當下燈/日光比例變，不是 source-intrinsic 的校正；實測 6 筆散佈 2.9×（1.92–5.55），那是不同的混合比例、不是雜訊。可修正的只有 `lamp/none` 12.1% + `daylight/diffuse` 1.3%。

所以 ±2% 通過**不代表**翻過去對整條 DLI 安全 —— 它驗的是八分之一的訊號。要涵蓋 mixed 需要的是**光源分解**（`lux_ref` 是環境光、`lux − lux_ref` 是燈的貢獻，各乘各的 k），那是 v2 設計，不是把 mixed 加進 `UNIVERSE` —— 加了也沒用，第 68 行先 return。

panels.title: item 2 — main lux ÷54: raw vs corrected
panels.description: raw = air.lux/54 (what production reads today). corrected = (lux × k_adopted[bh1750_lux_main × context])/54 via the canonical join. Context unknown/mixed, out-of-matrix cells, or a still-seed bucket all multiply seed(1.0) so the lines coincide — divergence only ever comes from an EARNED adoption. Records are built with `with` so range's _start/_stop survive into aggregateWindow.

targets.query:
import "array"
import "date"
import "join"
k = union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "sensors")
    |> range(start: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k_adopted" and (r._field == "value" or r._field == "adoption_state"))
    |> last()
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["target", "source", "regime", "epoch"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.target == "bh1750_lux_main")
    |> keep(columns: ["source", "regime", "epoch", "value", "adoption_state"])
    |> group(),
  array.from(rows: [{source: "__dummy__", regime: "__dummy__", epoch: "__dummy__", value: 0.0, adoption_state: "__dummy__"}])])
  |> group()
ctx = union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "sensors")
    |> range(start: date.sub(d: 5m, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "light_context" and r.location == "livingroom")
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "source", "regime", "epoch_lux_main"])
    |> group(),
  array.from(rows: [{_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, source: "__dummy__", regime: "__dummy__", epoch_lux_main: "__dummy__"}])])
  |> group()
raw = union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "sensors")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "air" and r._field == "lux" and r.device == "livingroom")
    // station-map note: single station today, device == location; the compute
    // side resolves the real map — this panel is observational
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with raw: r._value, cell: date.truncate(t: r._time, unit: 5m) }))
    |> group(),
  array.from(rows: [{_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, raw: 0.0, cell: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z}])])
  |> group()
j1 = join.left(left: raw, right: ctx,
  on: (l, r) => l.cell == r._time,
  as: (l, r) => ({ l with
    src: if exists r.source then r.source else "unknown",
    reg: if exists r.regime then r.regime else "unknown",
    ep: if exists r.epoch_lux_main then r.epoch_lux_main else "" }))
j2 = join.left(left: j1, right: k,
  on: (l, r) => l.src == r.source and l.reg == r.regime and l.ep == r.epoch,
  as: (l, r) => ({ l with
    k: if l.src == "unknown" or l.src == "mixed"
         or not ((l.src == "daylight" and (l.reg == "diffuse" or l.reg == "direct")) or (l.src == "lamp" and l.reg == "none"))
         or not exists r.value
       then 1.0 else r.value }))
union(tables: [
  j2 |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r.raw / 54.0, series: "raw" })),
  j2 |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r.raw * r.k / 54.0, series: "corrected" }))])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time > 1971-01-01T00:00:00Z)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_start", "_stop", "_value", "series"])
  |> group(columns: ["series", "_start", "_stop"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: item 2 — correction flag per 5-min cell
panels.description: What the join decided for each cell of the main-lux consumer: ok = an earned k applied; seed = bucket exists but never earned adoption (numerically uncorrected); unknown/mixed/out-of-matrix = the blueprint's honest fallbacks. A parallel period that is all seed/fallback is SAFE but proves nothing — the flip gate wants ok cells.

targets.query:
import "array"
import "join"
k = union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "sensors")
    |> range(start: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k_adopted" and (r._field == "value" or r._field == "adoption_state"))
    |> last()
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["target", "source", "regime", "epoch"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.target == "bh1750_lux_main")
    |> keep(columns: ["source", "regime", "epoch", "value", "adoption_state"])
    |> group(),
  array.from(rows: [{source: "__dummy__", regime: "__dummy__", epoch: "__dummy__", value: 0.0, adoption_state: "__dummy__"}])])
  |> group()
ctx = union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "sensors")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "light_context" and r.location == "livingroom")
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "source", "regime", "epoch_lux_main"])
    |> group(),
  array.from(rows: [{_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, source: "__dummy__", regime: "__dummy__", epoch_lux_main: "__dummy__"}])])
  |> group()
join.left(left: ctx, right: k,
  on: (l, r) => l.source == r.source and l.regime == r.regime and l.epoch_lux_main == r.epoch,
  as: (l, r) => ({ _time: l._time,
    _value: if l.source == "__dummy__" then "unknown"
      else if l.source == "unknown" then "unknown"
      else if l.source == "mixed" then "mixed"
      else if not ((l.source == "daylight" and (l.regime == "diffuse" or l.regime == "direct")) or (l.source == "lamp" and l.regime == "none")) then "out-of-matrix"
      else if not exists r.value then "unknown"
      else if r.adoption_state == "seed" then "seed"
      else "ok" }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time > 1971-01-01T00:00:00Z)
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.description: raw = air.lux_ref/54. corrected joins bh1750_lux_ref — its legal matrix is daylight-only, so every lamp/none/mixed/unknown cell multiplies seed(1.0) and the lines coincide there by design.

panels.title: item 1 — spectrum PPFD: hardcoded CAL vs adopted bucket
panels.description: raw = 0.0017469 × S (what air.json panel 9/11/12 hardcodes today). corrected = k_adopted[as7341_ppfd × context] × S. S is the same counts integral as the production panels; saturated samples are dropped the same way; every fallback multiplies CAL so the lines coincide until a bucket earns adoption.

targets.query:
import "array"
import "date"
import "join"
CAL = 0.0017469
k = union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "sensors")
    |> range(start: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k_adopted" and (r._field == "value" or r._field == "adoption_state"))
    |> last()
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["target", "source", "regime", "epoch"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.target == "as7341_ppfd")
    |> keep(columns: ["source", "regime", "epoch", "value", "adoption_state"])
    |> group(),
  array.from(rows: [{source: "__dummy__", regime: "__dummy__", epoch: "__dummy__", value: 0.0, adoption_state: "__dummy__"}])])
  |> group()
ctx = union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "sensors")
    |> range(start: date.sub(d: 5m, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "light_context" and r.location == "livingroom")
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "source", "regime", "epoch_as7341"])
    |> group(),
  array.from(rows: [{_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, source: "__dummy__", regime: "__dummy__", epoch_as7341: "__dummy__"}])])
  |> group()
raw = union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "sensors")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "spectrum" and r.mode == "ambient" and r.device == "livingroom" and (r._field == "f415" or r._field == "f445" or r._field == "f480" or r._field == "f515" or r._field == "f555" or r._field == "f590" or r._field == "f630" or r._field == "f680" or r._field == "saturated"))
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.f415 and exists r.f445 and exists r.f480 and exists r.f515 and exists r.f555 and exists r.f590 and exists r.f630 and exists r.f680)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => (not exists r.saturated or r.saturated == 0.0) and r.f415 < 65535.0 and r.f445 < 65535.0 and r.f480 < 65535.0 and r.f515 < 65535.0 and r.f555 < 65535.0 and r.f590 < 65535.0 and r.f630 < 65535.0 and r.f680 < 65535.0)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with s: r.f415/55.0*415.0 + r.f445/110.0*445.0 + r.f480/210.0*480.0 + r.f515/390.0*515.0 + r.f555/590.0*555.0 + r.f590/840.0*590.0 + r.f630/1350.0*630.0 + r.f680/1070.0*680.0, cell: date.truncate(t: r._time, unit: 5m) }))
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_start", "_stop", "s", "cell"])
    |> group(),
  array.from(rows: [{_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, s: 0.0, cell: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z}])])
  |> group()
j1 = join.left(left: raw, right: ctx,
  on: (l, r) => l.cell == r._time,
  as: (l, r) => ({ l with
    src: if exists r.source then r.source else "unknown",
    reg: if exists r.regime then r.regime else "unknown",
    ep: if exists r.epoch_as7341 then r.epoch_as7341 else "" }))
j2 = join.left(left: j1, right: k,
  on: (l, r) => l.src == r.source and l.reg == r.regime and l.ep == r.epoch,
  as: (l, r) => ({ l with
    k: if l.src == "unknown" or l.src == "mixed"
         or not ((l.src == "daylight" and (l.reg == "diffuse" or l.reg == "direct")) or (l.src == "lamp" and l.reg == "none"))
         or not exists r.value
       then CAL else r.value }))
union(tables: [
  j2 |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: CAL * r.s, series: "raw (CAL)" })),
  j2 |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r.k * r.s, series: "corrected" }))])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time > 1971-01-01T00:00:00Z)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_start", "_stop", "_value", "series"])
  |> group(columns: ["series", "_start", "_stop"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: daily integral delta — the ±2% acceptance gate (item 2)
panels.description: Per Taipei day: integral(corrected, 1s)/integral(raw, 1s) − 1, the SAME integral the production DLI panels use — a plain sample sum would drift from it whenever telemetry has gaps or k changes across cells. Gate: 7 consecutive days inside ±2% (both directions red outside).

targets.query:
import "array"
import "date"
import "join"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Taipei")
k = union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "sensors")
    |> range(start: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k_adopted" and (r._field == "value" or r._field == "adoption_state"))
    |> last()
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["target", "source", "regime", "epoch"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.target == "bh1750_lux_main")
    |> keep(columns: ["source", "regime", "epoch", "value", "adoption_state"])
    |> group(),
  array.from(rows: [{source: "__dummy__", regime: "__dummy__", epoch: "__dummy__", value: 0.0, adoption_state: "__dummy__"}])])
  |> group()
ctx = union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "sensors")
    |> range(start: date.sub(d: 5m, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "light_context" and r.location == "livingroom")
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "source", "regime", "epoch_lux_main"])
    |> group(),
  array.from(rows: [{_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, source: "__dummy__", regime: "__dummy__", epoch_lux_main: "__dummy__"}])])
  |> group()
raw = union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "sensors")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "air" and r._field == "lux" and r.device == "livingroom")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with raw: r._value, cell: date.truncate(t: r._time, unit: 5m) }))
    |> group(),
  array.from(rows: [{_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, raw: 0.0, cell: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z}])])
  |> group()
j1 = join.left(left: raw, right: ctx,
  on: (l, r) => l.cell == r._time,
  as: (l, r) => ({ l with
    src: if exists r.source then r.source else "unknown",
    reg: if exists r.regime then r.regime else "unknown",
    ep: if exists r.epoch_lux_main then r.epoch_lux_main else "" }))
j2 = join.left(left: j1, right: k,
  on: (l, r) => l.src == r.source and l.reg == r.regime and l.ep == r.epoch,
  as: (l, r) => ({ l with
    cor: l.raw * (if l.src == "unknown" or l.src == "mixed"
      or not ((l.src == "daylight" and (l.reg == "diffuse" or l.reg == "direct")) or (l.src == "lamp" and l.reg == "none"))
      or not exists r.value then 1.0 else r.value) }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time > 1971-01-01T00:00:00Z)
rs = j2 |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r.raw }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_start", "_stop", "_value"])
  |> group(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: (column, tables=<-) => tables |> integral(unit: 1s), createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, rawint: r._value }))
  |> group()
cs = j2 |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r.cor }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_start", "_stop", "_value"])
  |> group(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: (column, tables=<-) => tables |> integral(unit: 1s), createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, corint: r._value }))
  |> group()
rsd = union(tables: [rs, array.from(rows: [{_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, rawint: 1.0}])]) |> group()
csd = union(tables: [cs, array.from(rows: [{_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, corint: 1.0}])]) |> group()
join.time(left: rsd, right: csd, as: (l, r) => ({ _time: l._time, delta_pct: (r.corint / l.rawint - 1.0) * 100.0 }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time > 1971-01-01T00:00:00Z)
  |> group()
